key_insight: MOPD integrates multiple domain-specific RL capabilities into one LLM by distilling several teachers onto the student’s own on-policy rollouts, avoiding exposure bias and improving capability retention.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical post-training recipe for frontier LLMs that supports parallel domain specialization and scalable capability fusion without tightly coupling training across domains.
method: Train separate domain-specific RL teachers for each capability.
Generate student rollouts on-policy and distill all teachers’ signals onto those trajectories.
Use dense supervision from multiple teachers to combine capabilities more effectively than off-policy or merge-based baselines.
evidence_signal: On Qwen3-30B-A3B, the abstract reports MOPD outperforms Mix-RL, Cascade RL, Off-Policy Finetune, and Param-Merge, retaining nearly all of each teacher’s capability; it is also deployed in MiMo-V2-Flash.
watch_item: The approach depends on having strong per-domain RL teachers and careful orchestration of multi-teacher distillation, which may increase training and integration complexity.
paper_title: MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training
